description: Cancel one post so it does not publish: its status becomes canceled and the record is kept. Posts that are already completed, failed, or canceled are rejected with 409. Pending auto-recycle entries for the post are left as they are; aidelly_cancel_scheduled_post also cancels those. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_cancel_post
title: Cancel Post
